First, note:  
Asia/Kolkata = UTC+5:30.  
US/Pacific = UTC-8 (assuming no DST, as per rules).  

Difference in offsets:  
target_offset − source_offset = (-8) − (+5.5) = -13.5 hours.  

Convert:  
04:00 (March 5, 1552, Kolkata) + (-13.5 hours) =  
04:00 − 13:30 = (04:00 − 12:00 = 16:00 previous day) − 1:30 = 14:30 previous day.  

So:  
04:00 March 5 − 13:30 = 14:30 March 4 (US/Pacific).  

FINAL_ANSWER: March 4, 14:30
